video.title: AI欧腐《假扮 Alpha 命定伴侣后，他不放我走了/I Faked Being the Alpha’s Mate》
video.desc:
Lowborn mutt Leo trespasses into the Apex Pack and lies that he is ruthless Alpha Alexander’s fated mate. His scent alone calms Alexander’s deadly rage. Hunted by a power-hungry elder, Leo awakens as a Shadow Spirit Wolf, commands the dead, and returns to save his Alpha, expose a coup, and claim his place as Luna.
出身低微的混血狼人Leo 擅自闯入顶级狼群 Apex Pack，并撒谎声称自己是冷酷 Alpha Alexander的命定伴侣。
没想到，仅凭他的气息，就能安抚Alexander濒临失控的致命怒火。
在一位野心勃勃的长老追杀下，Leo觉醒为罕见的影灵狼，拥有号令亡灵的力量。最终，他归来拯救自己的 Alpha，揭穿篡位阴谋，并以 Luna 的身份夺回属于自己的位置。
